name: Greek Chicken Smash Tacos with Dill Yogurt & Cucumber-Tomato Salad

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 tomatoes
1 ½ English cucumbers
1 ½ orange bell peppers
1 small bunch fresh dill
1 ½ lemons

instructions.primary_message: Place oil, vinegar, and spices in a large bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
extra virgin olive oil
3 tbsp red wine vinegar
¾ tsp garlic powder
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Small dice tomatoes. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Small dice cucumbers. Add to the bowl.
Trim, seed, and small dice bell peppers. Add to the bowl.
Roughly chop olives. Add to the bowl and stir to combine the salad. Set aside.
Peel and mince shallot. Place in a medium bowl along with chicken and spices. Mix with your hands until well combined.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 shallot
680 g ground chicken
1 ½ tsp oregano, dried
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Arrange tortillas on a flat surface, then divide the chicken mixture between them (about 2 tablespoons per tortilla). Using a knife (or your hands), spread the chicken mixture over the surface of each tortilla in an even layer.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches, add tacos, meat-side down. Cook, pressing down once with the bottom of a spatula halfway through cooking, until the chicken is cooked through, about 3 minutes.
Flip tacos, chicken-side up, and continue to cook until tortillas are golden underneath, 1 minute more. Transfer to a large plate and carefully fold in half to form tacos.
Meanwhile, shave dill leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place in a small bowl.
Juice lemons into the bowl with the dill. Add yogurt, sugar, and salt, then stir to combine the dill yogurt.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 cup plain Greek yogurt
¾ tsp brown sugar
salt

instructions.primary_message: Divide tacos between plates. Fill each with a small portion of salad and drizzle with dill yogurt. Serve with remaining salad on the side and enjoy!
